note: Spike 4 second tier: the 100k-task blocking-load matrix on the Kaggle worker (4 cores, native Linux — also re-measures the enter/exit pair cost without the sandbox's intercepted syscalls). Thresholds pre-registered in spikes/spike4-scheduling/RESULTS.md.

commands.name: spike4-run
commands.run: export PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && unset CARGO_TARGET_DIR && export SPIKE4_WORKER=1 SPIKE4_POOL_THREADS=256 SPIKE4_M4N=5000 && cd spikes/spike4-scheduling/work && bash run.sh 2>&1

commands.name: collect-results
commands.run: cd spikes/spike4-scheduling/work && mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR/go" && cp matrix.out canary.out race.out m4.out bench.sandbox.out verdicts.out go/matrix.sandbox.jsonl "$RESULTS_DIR/" 2>/dev/null; cp go/matrix.worker.jsonl "$RESULTS_DIR/go/" 2>/dev/null; ls -la "$RESULTS_DIR/"
